items.briefing:
A new report from Elastic warns that Australian businesses are largely unprepared for cyber attacks powered by artificial intelligence, which are becoming more sophisticated and harder to detect. This is a timely reminder for local organisations to review their defences and ensure staff know how to spot unusual activity.

Security researcher Troy Hunt has also highlighted the importance of verifying data breach claims before acting on them, noting that not all breach reports are accurate. If you receive an alert claiming your organisation's data has been leaked, check through official channels before taking drastic action. **Tip:** Always verify breach notifications through trusted sources like Have I Been Pwned before sharing them internally.

featured.title: Australian firms unready for AI cyber attacks, Elastic
